statement: Subgraph context is already integrated into LLM fine-tuning in prior work: DrKGC uses a GCN adapter over a retrieved subgraph and integrates the resulting structural embeddings into the prompt for LLM fine-tuning.

evidence.quote: Finally, a graph convolutional network (GCN) adapter uses the retrieved subgraph to enhance the structural embeddings, which are then integrated into the prompt for effective LLM fine-tuning.
